privacy: Privacy policy Last updated 21 November 2026 Macro collects as little as it can. This page lists everything it stores, why, and how to have it removed. In short We store Waitlist email, account info (if signed in), and run data We never Sell it or share it for marketing Runs Demo runs are public; own-site runs are private to your account Cookies Only a session cookie when you sign in To delete Account settings (signed in) or hello@macro.my.id On this page Who we are The waitlist Using the app (demo and accounts) Services that process data for us Cookies Your rights Changes Who we are Macro is a load-testing service run from macro.my.id. For any question about your data, or to have it removed, write to hello@macro.my.id . The waitlist When you join the waitlist we store your email address and the time you signed up. Nothing else: not your name, and not your IP address (it is held in memory for up to an hour, only to limit sign-ups, and is never written down). We use your email only to notify you once if paid plans with higher user and run limits launch, plus anything essential about that change. We never sell it, share it for marketing, or add it to other lists. We keep it until the hosted product launches and for as long as you stay subscribed after that. Ask us at hello@macro.my.id and we delete it, usually within seven days. Using the app (demo and accounts) The traffic descriptions you type, the plans drafted from them and the results of each run are stored in Macro's database. Demo runs are public (anyone with a run's link can open its page), so do not put personal data in a traffic description. If you sign in (with Google, GitHub, or an email magic link), we store your email address, optional OAuth account identity, your verified HTTPS origin and verification token, any saved draft text, and your private own-site runs. When you verify and draft a test for your own site, Macro fetches public documents and scripts from that origin to discover safe routes for the planner. Your traffic description and the measured results are sent to serverless LLM inference, which drafts the plan, advises between stages and writes the report explanation. Scenario Assistant and Report Q&A run on your device via Chrome Gemini Nano when available; otherwise, requests are routed to Google Cloud Gemini via Firebase AI Logic with App Check attestation. Your IP address is recorded with a timestamp when you draft a plan or start a run while signed out, so we can enforce per-person limits. These records are deleted automatically after 24 hours. The list of recent runs on the planner page is kept in your own browser (local storage) unless you claim them onto an account. Services that process data for us Vultr hosts Macro's servers and database in Singapore and runs the AI models. Cloudflare sits in front of the site for security and delivery, runs Turnstile (the check that you are a person, not a bot) on forms, and provides privacy-first page analytics without cookies. Resend sends sign-in magic links and waitlist emails when you request them. Google and Firebase handle Google OAuth sign-in, Firebase App Check client attestation, Firebase Remote Config for client AI settings, Cloud Firestore for public read-only scenario templates, report Q&A prompts, featured sample runs, and live status notices (cached locally in your browser), and cloud Gemini inference fallback when on-device Gemini Nano is not available. GitHub handles OAuth sign-in if you choose to sign in with GitHub. Tiger Cloud receives public demo-run per-second metrics when configured; private own-site runs are not sent there. Each processes data under its own privacy policy and only to provide its part of the service. Cookies Macro uses no advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. Signed-out browsing sets no cookies of its own; if you sign in, Macro sets an HttpOnly session cookie solely to keep you signed in. If you switch between light and dark mode, that choice is kept in your browser's local storage and never sent to us. Your rights If you have an account, you can delete it directly from Account (this immediately removes your account, verified origin, saved draft, and private runs, and unlinks any public demo runs). For waitlist entries, questions about what we hold, or corrections, write to hello@macro.my.id . We answer within 30 days. Changes If this policy changes, the date at the top changes too. A change that affects the waitlist is announced by email first.

They are an estimate, not a guarantee of how your site behaves under real traffic. The AI-written explanation is checked against the measured numbers, but it can still be wrong; the measured numbers are the source of truth.
